current_task.title: Performance and visual stability
current_task.objective: Reduce client overhead, cascade complexity and layout instability while preserving the locked five-viewport product contract.
current_task.next_action: Continue B7 with measured startup/runtime profiling, prioritizing repeated work during search/results/selected-tour lifecycle over speculative one-time micro-cleanups. Re-audit the full V2 journey periodically. Keep the lead-form-guard selectedTour MutationObserver intact unless a safe pre-mutation lifecycle contract is introduced and proven; public programmatic selectTour() can mutate selectedTour before v2:tour-selected. Do not bundle JS merely to reduce request count.
